stay.price_basis: Mid (n=6): Dangamal Nature Camp (5 cottages, tariff card) plus Gupti Nature Camp 'From Rs 3,600 / night' on the official EcoTour Odisha stays list (ecotourodisha.com/stays-camps, viewed 2026-10-09, undated 'from' price). Dangamal (Odisha forest department eco-tourism camp) tariff card as printed on odishatour.in, undated (page shows only a 2025 copyright), per night for 2 adults, excluding tax, ALL-INCLUSIVE of breakfast, lunch, dinner and a one-time creek boating charge. Not a 18-19 Nov Cleartrip price. Budget and dorm: OTDC Aranyanivas Chandbali (Odisha tourism corporation, gateway town for Bhitarkanika boat trips) published tariff 1 Oct-30 Jun, undated beyond that: AC double Rs 1,700, non-AC double Rs 990 (median 1,345, n=2 room types of one property), dormitory Rs 450 per bed (8-bed room); bed tea and breakfast included, GST extra. otdc.in did not load in my browser (timeouts), so these figures come from a search-result extract of that page; re-check.
stay.notes: Six values: 3,500; 3,500; 3,600 (Gupti, official 'from'); 4,000; 4,000; 4,000; median 3,800. Tariff card: Bani Bhawan AC double 4,000; Hental House AC 3-bed 4,000; Sundari Bhawan AC double 3,500; Heron House AC double 4,000; Cheetal Cottage AC double 3,500; extra person 4-18 yrs 1,000. Because meals and boating are bundled, do not add food on top for the nights spent here. ecotourodisha.com (official portal) lists the same cottages and confirms 'All Bhitarkanika tariffs are all-inclusive meals' but shows 'Price unavailable' without a booking session. Cleartrip: SandPebbles Bhitarkanika Jungle Resorts and Chukapahad Farm Resort (Rajnagar) both returned 'No rooms available' for 18-19 Nov 2026, so no dated OTA price. Private resort figures seen but not used (undated or other dates): Jungle Avengers (Khola) 'prices start at 2,900'; Tripadvisor 18-19 Oct dates show Sand Pebbles from 6,195. Boat transfer from Gupti or Khola is mandatory to reach Dangamal.
